docs.text: Welcome to Pineapple SMP !! Pineapple SMP (PSMP) is the third server in a line of related Minecraft SMPs. PSMP is run by Kiwian (KiwianDoesThings) . This wiki was made by Kiwian, with the help of members of the PSMP, and was suggested by Nyx (Nyxophene) This wiki should cover all important aspects of the PSMP, as well as link to all connected pages .
